mapper.select: SELECT id,file_name,file_format,source_id,imported_by,status,total_rows,success_rows,failed_rows,duplicate_rows,structure_errors,duplicate_warnings FROM exam_import_batch WHERE id=#{batchId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,batch_id,row_number,payload,question_fingerprint,group_fingerprint,status FROM exam_import_item WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY row_number,id FOR UPDATE
SELECT fingerprint FROM exam_import_fingerprint_reservation WHERE fingerprint=#{fingerprint} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM exam_question WHERE content_fingerprint=#{fingerprint} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM exam_question_group WHERE content_fingerprint=#{fingerprint} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM exam_import_fingerprint_reservation WHERE fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exam_question WHERE content_fingerprint=#{fingerprint}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exam_question_group WHERE content_fingerprint=#{fingerprint}) AND (batch_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM exam_import_batch b WHERE b.id=exam_import_fingerprint_reservation.batch_id AND b.status IN ('UPLOADED','VALIDATED')))
DELETE FROM exam_import_fingerprint_reservation WHERE fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND batch_id=#{batchId}
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_import_item SET status='IMPORTED' WHERE id=#{itemId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE exam_import_item SET status='DUPLICATE' WHERE id=#{itemId} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE exam_import_batch SET status='IMPORTED', imported_by=COALESCE(imported_by,#{adminId}), success_rows=#{successRows}, failed_rows=#{failedRows}, duplicate_rows=#{duplicateRows}, duplicate_warnings=#{duplicateWarnings} WHERE id=#{batchId} AND status='VALIDATED' AND (imported_by IS NULL OR imported_by=#{adminId})
